faq.title: A few things before you start.

photos.question: What kind of photo should I upload?
photos.answer: A clear photo of a single product works best. It doesn’t need a studio: a phone photo on a plain background is enough.

rights.question: Can I use the images commercially?
rights.answer: Yes. Use the images you create in your store, ads, marketplace listings and social posts.

credits.question: How do credits work?
credits.answer: Each generation uses credits. The free plan includes 100 credits a month; paid plans include more, and every charge shows up in your history.

failed.question: What if a generation fails?
failed.answer: The credits go straight back to your balance. You only pay for results you receive.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. Manage or cancel your subscription from the billing page; your plan stays active until the end of the current period.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: See our refund policy for the details. If something looks wrong with a charge, contact us and we’ll sort it out.

acquisition.title: Acquisition
acquisition.description: Sign-ups and paying customers over the last {days} days (UTC), grouped by the source frozen at sign-up.
acquisition.sourcesHint: Sources are frozen at sign-up. “No attribution” means there is no usable source: the visit was never recorded, was declined, expired, or happened on another device. “Direct” means the visitor arrived without a campaign, for example by typing the address. A campaign that literally sends utm_source=unknown is a separate row, spelled as sent.
acquisition.pendingHint: Net revenue is refund-adjusted as of now, so past periods change as refunds come in. Orders whose amount is not known yet — usually because a refund arrived before its payment record — count as neither revenue nor paying customers; their refunds so far are listed under “To reconcile”. A 0 there means nothing has been refunded yet, not that the order is settled.
acquisition.empty: No channel data in this period. Attribution only records visits after it is switched on, so earlier sign-ups show up under “No attribution”.
acquisition.leadsHint: Confirmed leads and conversion rates change when leads are withdrawn or deleted. Only confirmed leads count toward the rate; unconfirmed leads are not included.

invite.acceptedBody: This invitation applies when you create a new account in this browser within 30 days.
invite.cleared: The earlier invitation was cleared. Nothing is stored now, so you can accept this one.
invite.otherBody: The first invitation you accepted stays in effect. Clear it first if you want to use this one instead.
invite.signedInBody: Invitations are recorded when a new account is created, so this one cannot be added to your existing account.
invite.selfTitle: This is your own invite link
invite.selfBody: Share it with someone who has not created an account yet.
invite.boundTitle: Your account already has an invitation
invite.boundBody: An account can be linked to one invitation only, and the link cannot be changed.
invite.invalidTitle: This invite link is not valid
invite.invalidBody: The link may be incomplete or mistyped, or the invitation may no longer be available.
invite.error: We could not complete your request. Please try again.
invite.rateLimited: Too many attempts from this browser. Please wait a moment and try again.
